reviews.name: Mike Payne
reviews.text: JMA Home Repair and Remodel LLC was referred to me by my Realtor and I couldn't be happier. I purchased a small condo in Palm Coast and did a full renovation. Matt and team took the lead and were wonderful throughout the entire renovation.

reviews.name: Diana Ames
reviews.text: I hired Matt to tile the backsplash in my newly remodeled kitchen. He did an absolutely wonderful job with it. He was very professional and meticulous very pleased with the results. He will be my go to guy for any additional remodeling projects.

reviews.name: Roxanne Cardone
reviews.text: Matt did a great job in renovating our kitchen, staying within our budget and did the little things to finish it off, to make it look better than expected. He and his team were respectful on time and made sure we were satisfied.
